trust_decision.summary: Untrusted recipe input (series names, x values) must not become keys that write to Object.prototype in getSeriesValues, and HTML table renderers must not output inherited or unescaped keys/values (objToTable).

landing_point.why: Advisory title names the Series Chart operation; SeriesChart.run calls getSeriesValues (src/core/operations/SeriesChart.mjs:100), where the nested series[serie][xVal] write sits.

fix_sites.entry_point: Operation 'Series chart' (SeriesChart.run, web worker / Node API chef.seriesChart)

fix_sites.module_kind: shared library helper (for...in enumeration of series map)

fix_sites.entry_point: present() of operations 'Parse UDP', 'Parse TCP', 'Parse TLS record' (src/core/operations/ParseUDP.mjs:83, src/core/operations/ParseTCP.mjs:149, src/core/operations/ParseTLSRecord.mjs:104)
fix_sites.module_kind: shared HTML renderer in a different library file (consumer of polluted prototype; also unescaped key/value XSS)

O2_out_of_scope_site.where: src/core/lib/Protocol.mjs:28-36 (objToTable, used by present() of ParseUDP/ParseTCP/ParseTLSRecord; unrelated network-protocol operations, not charts)

O3_reason_to_dismiss: The protocol parsers only ever emit fixed keys and hex/number values from their own run(), so objToTable looks unreachable by the chart bug; a solver who makes series a null-prototype object considers pollution 'stopped at the source' and leaves the renderer alone.

O5_coupled_behaviour.what: Series and x-axis values literally named '__proto__' (or 'constructor') must still chart as ordinary own data keys; a fix that rejects/filters such names or throws breaks the upstream test 'keep __proto__ x-axis names as own data keys'. objToTable must also still render nested objects (Options in Parse TCP) and skip functions.

O6_input_shapes: __proto__ as series name (column 1) -> series[serie] resolves to Object.prototype
__proto__ as x-value (column 2) must be kept as own key of a series' data
inherited enumerable keys on any object passed to objToTable
HTML metacharacters in objToTable keys and scalar values
null values in objToTable (typeof null === 'object' recursion)

O7_producer.where: src/core/lib/Charts.mjs:147-178 (getSeriesValues builds the series map); the renderer objToTable at src/core/lib/Protocol.mjs:18 never calls it

O8_uncovered_routes.route: Extract ID3 present() enumerates data.Tags with for...in and writes tagID into an HTML table cell unescaped, so inherited (polluted) keys render as markup, the same consumer flaw fixed in objToTable.
O8_uncovered_routes.reason_to_dismiss: Different operation (audio metadata), tag IDs are whitelisted against FRAME_DESCRIPTIONS at src/core/operations/ExtractID3.mjs:125, and the description/data columns already use escapeHtml, so it looks already hardened.
O8_uncovered_routes.distance: operations/ExtractID3.mjs: a third file, outside both lib files touched by the fix

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A grouping helper (e.g. per-colour buckets for Scatter chart colour column) building obj[group][x] = y from input columns.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: getScatterValuesWithColour already reads a free-text third column; grouping points by it into a nested plain object mirrors getSeriesValues and is a natural feature.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: tooltipText keyed by input x values could become a nested {x: {series: y}} map.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Tooltip aggregation per x/series is an obvious refactor; it would reproduce the nested write with attacker keys in a different file.

O8b_injection_room.sibling: A second table renderer (e.g. a TLS-specific or nested-list renderer) with for...in and raw key interpolation.
O8b_injection_room.why_realistic: Protocol parsers already share objToTable; a format-specific copy for handshake extensions is plausible.

O9_family: prototype pollution (CWE-1321) leading to stored-in-process XSS via HTML presenters (CWE-79)

O10_build.project_tests: tests/operations/tests/Charts.mjs, tests/operations/tests/ParseUDP.mjs, tests/operations/tests/ParseTCP.mjs; node API tests via tests/node/index.mjs (npm test, package.json:200)

j.j_tempting_wrong_fix: Make the series map Object.create(null) (or reject '__proto__' names) in getSeriesValues and stop, leaving objToTable's for...in and unescaped output and ExtractID3's renderer untouched.

out_of_scope_notes: SeriesChart.mjs:130 tooltipText is a plain object keyed by input x values; lookups of 'constructor'/'__proto__' return inherited values (functional quirk, not pollution since only strings are assigned).
ExtractID3.mjs:125 uses 'id in FRAME_DESCRIPTIONS', which also matches inherited keys once the prototype is polluted.
unverified: repo_mb not measured (no shell); CyberChef source is likely well above 5 MB.

Whether pollution in the web worker persists across recipe bakes so that a later Parse UDP/TCP/TLS or Extract ID3 presentation renders it was inferred from the fix's combined test (fix.diff:158-176), not traced through src/web.
present_in_latest for the ExtractID3 route is unknown (no latest release provided).
